en: Welcome back, Captain!\nYou must be tired after\ntoday's mission.
Oh, what do you have\nthere? It looks like a\nshard of glass.
I know, but the captain\ninsisted we bring it back.
Roger that! I will analyze\nthe object at once!
If I could just borrow it for\na―
Ah!!!
What the―!? Why's it\nsuddenly glowing like\nthat?
Eek!
Ngh.
At last, I've awakened.
Ah!!!

No need to be so alarmed.
I am <font color=yellow>Lenneth Valkyrie</font>, god
and creator of the
universe.
Oh, but I see you come\nfrom a different universe\nthan the one I created.
Where is this place? That\nis not such a simple\nquestion.

This is a failed attempt at
universe creation by a
man known as <font color=yellow>Lezard
Valeth</font>.

In an effort to stabilize
this universe, he placed a
fake version of me at the
very center.

However, the resulting
<font color=yellow>homunculus</font> with its
artificial soul wasn't up to
the task.

Realizing his blunder,
Lezard abandoned this
universe, but his creation
is now spiraling out of
control.
It has started expanding,\nswallowing up all that\ncrosses its path.
And it seems you were no\nexception.
But...!

There's no need to panic. I
will forge a path for you
to return to your
comrades.

However, I am but a
disembodied spirit at the
moment. As such, it is
difficult to maintain my
form for long.

So, I will lend you my
strength via the power of
the <font color=yellow>einherjar</font> which
slumbers within you.
Now, open your eyes!
Captain!!!

Captain, you really had us
worried there! You
suddenly disappeared
when that shard of glass
emitted a flash of light.

Then we started twinkling
like little stars, and before
we knew it, we were in a
peaceful, sun-drenched
meadow.

So, we enjoyed a little
time in the sun before we
realized you were gone.
Then we started to really
panic!
Urk!
From that reply, I see\nyou're back to your old\nself. That's a relief.

I was really worried about
you, Captain. I mean, when
you disappeared like that,
I didn't know what to do.
Ngh!
Is something the matter,\n<font color=yellow>Silmeria</font>?
Oh, Captain... This is\nSilmeria. We met her while\ntrying to find you.
I sense the hand of\nLenneth upon you. Did you\ncome across her?
In short, this is an\nabandoned world created\nby Lezard.

He is no better than
garbage―a menace of a
man who brings harm to
others.

I think I know where this is
going. We have to find and
defeat this Lezard
character! So what are we
waiting for!?

No, that is a task for
others. Our objective is to
find a way to escape this
world.
Hmmm...
Escape? And just how\nexactly are we supposed\nto do that?
Hm!?
It's a path...of light?
It seems Lenneth is\nshowing us the way. Let's\nfollow it.
Ah!!!
Lenneth!
...Silmeria.
Were you trapped here\nwithin a homunculus?
No, I am now part of this\nartificial creation.
I'm but a tiny sliver of\nLenneth's soul dwelling\nwithin this creature.
Is it the same for you,\nSilmeria?
Ngh.
Now I see. We, the three\ngoddesses of fate, are...
I am happy to see you\nagain, no matter the form\nor circumstance.
Sister...
To think the day would\ncome when I gave thanks\nto that man...

Ack! It seems this
universe has lost its
foundation and will soon
meet its end.
Thank you for your help.\nThis universe is no longer\na danger.

Don't mention it. Besides,
we're not the kind of
people who look the other
way when faced with
situations like that.
I see... In any event, I am\nin your debt.

This universe won't last
much longer. I shall build a
bridge to the universe you
came from.
Sister, I'll help, too.
Great, thank you! May we\nmeet again sometime,\nsomewhere!
Yes, and should we meet\nagain, I pledge to lend you\nmy strength.
Then we'll become your\neinherjar. How delightful!
Until that day\ncomes...farewell.
Wow, we made it back!
What is it, Evelysse? Are\nyou not happy to be\nback?
No, I'm happy about that,\nit's just...

I can't stop thinking about
how sad those two sisters
looked. I mean, they hadn't
seen each other for some
time, so shouldn't they be
happy?

The captain's right.
Lenneth and her sister
have their own battles to
fight.
And unless you have\nforgotten, we have our\nown battles to fight, too.
All right then, let's get\nback on course. Let's get\ngoing, Coro!
Roger that! Full speed\nahead!
